full_track.tags: K-Pop ballad with jazz-pop influences. The arrangement features a fingerstyle acoustic guitar, a warm upright bass, and a soft jazz drum kit using brushes on the snare. A grand piano provides melodic fills and harmonic support. The male lead vocal is a baritone with a smooth, conversational delivery. The tempo is 72 BPM in 4/4 time. The acoustic guitar plays a steady eighth-note pattern while the upright bass emphasizes the downbeats with occasional melodic slides. The piano enters with staccato chords in the higher register during the verse transitions.
